title: `obj_make_compatible` has cyclomatic complexity 31 (threshold: 15)
detail: Lizard reports CCN=31 (51 NLOC). The function chains version comparisons with nested if/elif to strip or rename fields for each target version. Suggested fix: use a version-dispatch table (same pattern as recommended for image_meta.py and compute_node.py).

title: FIXME comment on load-bearing `image_type` field
detail: Line 264 contains `# FIXME: image_type should be enum?` on the definition of the `image_type` field. The field is used throughout the migration data path; if the type is wrong or incomplete, live-migration operations may silently accept invalid values. Suggested fix: resolve the enum question and either introduce a typed enum field or close the FIXME with a documented rationale.
